tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, inputs on bg.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, ghost buttons, menu items.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill on rows, ghost and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers. Not for controls.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders; 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and headings on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, domains, dates, placeholders; 4.5:1+ on bg, surface, surface-hover, surface-pressed and accent-bg.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: one main action per view (Add link).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sage: favorite star, active icons, links-with-meaning; 4.9:1 on surface light, 7.7:1 dark. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: Sage tint: active nav item, tag chips, selected row.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text on accent-bg (8:1+).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus-visible ring on every control; 4:1 on white, 8:1 on dark bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, error text and icons on surface.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner and field error background; danger text on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved/confirmed toasts icon and text on surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Duplicate-link warning text and icon on surface.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Duplicate-link warning background; warning text on it.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the mobile menu.

tokens.name: logo-bookmark
tokens.usage: Only the bookmark notch of the logo mark, on primary (the card). Not for UI.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted floating layers only: menus, toasts, the phone tab bar, the bulk bar, the sign-in card. Opaque enough for 4.5:1 text without the blur.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: 1px edge of a glass layer, so it reads on any background.

tokens.name: folder-graphite
tokens.usage: Graphite folder: icon glyph, on folder-graphite-bg (4.5:1). Applied with the class fc-graphite.

tokens.name: folder-graphite-bg
tokens.usage: Graphite folder: icon tile behind folder-graphite.

tokens.name: folder-sage
tokens.usage: Sage folder: icon glyph, on folder-sage-bg (4.5:1). Applied with the class fc-sage.

tokens.name: folder-sage-bg
tokens.usage: Sage folder: icon tile behind folder-sage.

tokens.name: folder-ocean-bg

tokens.name: folder-plum-bg
tokens.usage: Plum folder: icon tile behind folder-plum.

tokens.name: folder-clay
tokens.usage: Clay folder: icon glyph, on folder-clay-bg (4.5:1). Applied with the class fc-clay.

tokens.name: folder-clay-bg
tokens.usage: Clay folder: icon tile behind folder-clay.

tokens.name: folder-amber
tokens.usage: Amber folder: icon glyph, on folder-amber-bg (4.5:1). Applied with the class fc-amber.

tokens.usage: Amber folder: icon tile behind folder-amber.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles (folder name, Trash, Appearance) and sign-in headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Saved to watch on the weekend

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, field labels, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Domains, dates, helper text — in text-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: URLs in the edit form, keyboard hints (⌘K).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, large section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inner parts: keyboard keys, the toast close button, calendar days.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, notices, menu items' container corners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and the desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, the phone frame's floating bars.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (pills), chips, saved views, the segmented control, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Reserved for a dragged card (drag and drop, later stages). Resting and hovered cards are flat with a border.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, select dropdowns, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards, panels and the sidebar: a whisper ring instead of a hairline border.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Glass layers and dialogs that float above the page.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press-down on buttons and rows.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, exits (menus, dialogs, toasts, spinners leaving).

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Entrances of menus, dialogs, spinners; content reveal; theme cross-fade.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Saving a link (card lands), toasts, bottom sheets and the mobile menu.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering or reacting to the user: menus, dialogs, toasts, spinners, press-down.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Only exits that leave the screen (toast, sheet dismissed).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving from one place to another on screen: feed cards shifting, tree expand.

tokens.name: ease-drawer
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the mobile menu sliding in.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small overshoot: card landing, star pop, press release. Never on large surfaces.
